entry.title: Stream 1.0.0
entry.summary: Stream 1.0.0 is an MPC effect. This zip was built with `tools/build_port.sh` and `tools/release.py` from [sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins), then checked with `tools/catalog_check.py --catalog`. `stream.so` is a 32-bit ARM hard-float plugin (uid `Strm`). The highest glibc symbol it needs is 2.17. Catalog id `stream`, license MIT. This build was not installed on a device from here. There is no CPU bench in the zip. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS stand
